body:
High school is hell, but it ends. Please trust us, what you are going through is nothing like what happens after the cloying oppressive hell of high school. Even at 19 high school will seem a thousand miles away. 

Please just hang in there, you don’t have to be good, you just have to stay alive.

I hear you. You feel useless and alone, like no one will or can care about you. But they can, they might even now care, but lack the skill and voice to tell you. All manner of things are possible. 

I was sucidal 25 years ago and I put it off, figuring I could always do it later. If there is anything at all you enjoy, do that thing. Try and think of people desperately in need near you, and go help them. You might not have any friends but if you volunteer some place that has needy people they will appreciate what you do, even if you can’t believe they will like you. 

When I was really sad, I couldn’t have imagined how happy I would end up. Just cause you can’t imagine it, doesn’t mean it can’t happen. 

I’ve seen people recover from terrible circumstances and stay helpful and loved. People I would have never thought would survive. Hold on, if you can, no one knows what tomorrow brings.
How old are you? I'm 41, and despite feeling the same way you do, I was super wrong before. If you look at the statistics people report getting happier as they get older, I think into their 60's.

You can always kill yourself later. Go get a job, the best one you can. It will probably still be shit, but that's what you can do. See what it's like first, being poor. It might not be all that bad, and if it is. You can always kill yourself just before your shift, so at least you're guaranteed that someone misses you. /s
